Promote one or more objects one lifecycle hop when preconditions pass.

IDs may be positional args, comma-separated (ID1,ID2), and/or --ids.

  Promote one object
  zqk object promote ATK-001
  Promote many (comma-separated)
  zqk object promote ATK-001,ATK-002,ATK-003

Usage:
  zqk object promote <id>[,id...] [id...] [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ids string              Comma-separated list of object IDs (same as positional multi-ID / comma lists)
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
      --to string               Target lifecycle status to advance through valid intermediate hops
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
